platformAndModeScope.activeMode: Story Mode (Single-Player — Jason Duval & Lucia Caminos)

onlineStatus.summary: Rockstar Games launched GTA VI on November 19, 2026 strictly as a single-player Story Mode experience on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. As of November 27, 2026, no GTA VI Online release date, multiplayer heist mechanics, public-lobby fail penalties, or 1.5X weekly event bonuses have been announced.
onlineStatus.evidenceClassification: Confirmed by official information or direct in-game verification

latestPatch.evidenceClassification: Confirmed by official information or direct in-game verification
confirmedOfficialFixes: Fixed several issues that caused the game to crash.
Fixed an issue that resulted in the weather not changing for extended periods.
Fixed an issue that resulted in the game not autosaving correctly.
Fixed several issues that resulted in phone calls not triggering correctly, including those that progressed the story or unlocked mission content.
Fixed an issue that resulted in the player being unable to lose their Wanted Level.
Fixed an issue that resulted in the player being unable to use the deadlift bar in the Gym.
Fixed an issue that resulted in partners not handing over bags so that players could sell them to fences.

pocketCashCap.notes: Each protagonist's loose pocket cash caps at $20,000; deposit cash at physical ATMs or via the BuckMe app into Family Savings to protect funds against Wasted/Busted losses.
pocketCashCap.evidenceClassification: Corroborated by multiple reputable launch guides

dyePackJammer.mechanic: Neutralizes security dye packs on marked bills during bank robberies; exact percentage loss without the jammer is not published by Rockstar and any percentage shown in calculators is an illustrative estimate.
dyePackJammer.evidenceClassification: Corroborated by multiple reputable launch guides

fencesAndBuyers.yasmaniNotes: Yasmani (Little Cuba) pays the highest corroborated in-person rate for jewelry and marked bills. His remote garage pickup service takes a driver cut; a fixed '5% cut' figure is community-reported/unverified and treated only as an adjustable estimator in calculators.
fencesAndBuyers.evidenceClassification: Corroborated by multiple reputable launch guides

safeAndKeypadCodes.randomizedFreeRoamSafesNote: Free-roam pawn shops (including Fast Cash in Little Cuba), jewelry boutiques, and convenience store safes generate randomized combinations per visit; use clerk intimidation or Focus Mode (L3+R3).
safeAndKeypadCodes.evidenceClassification: Corroborated by multiple reputable launch guides

cartel-heist.name: The Cartel Heist (Sinfrontera National Bank)
cartel-heist.evidenceClassification: Corroborated by multiple reputable launch guides
cartel-heist.notes: Chapter 3 Story Heist #1 with Raul Bautista (5 setups + 10-step vault job). Baseline payout $120,000; some launch walkthroughs report up to $150,000 depending on execution.

vcia-takedown.name: VCIA Takedown (Vice City International Airport)
vcia-takedown.evidenceClassification: Corroborated by multiple reputable launch guides
vcia-takedown.notes: Chapter 4 Story Heist #2 (4 setups + airport finale). Unlocks Hi-Jacked trophy.

operation-savage-glory.name: Operation Savage Glory (Coast Guard Raid)
operation-savage-glory.evidenceClassification: Corroborated by multiple reputable launch guides
operation-savage-glory.notes: Chapter 5 story mission given by Vinny Capsik (follows Doggie Bag, leads into Honest Abe). Pays $50,000, grants Pegassi Residences Penthouse access, restores confiscated gear, and unlocks the Snow Storm trophy.

large-banks.name: 8 Large Bank Vaults (Endgame Repeatable)
large-banks.evidenceClassification: Corroborated by multiple reputable launch guides
large-banks.notes: 8 major free-roam vaults unlocked at the end of Chapter 4 ('That's Where The Money Is...'). Bring Dye Pack Jammer.

small-banks.name: 14 Small Banks & Payday Loans
small-banks.evidenceClassification: Corroborated by multiple reputable launch guides
small-banks.notes: 14 regional bank/payday branches unlocked in Chapter 3 after Credit Check (which also grants the Dye Pack Jammer).

jewelry-stores.name: 20 Jewelry Stores (Yasmani Gem Fence)
jewelry-stores.evidenceClassification: Corroborated by multiple reputable launch guides
jewelry-stores.completionTimeNote: Completion time varies widely by boutique tier, stealth vs. loud exit, and drive distance to Yasmani in Little Cuba; an earlier hardcoded 11-minute estimate was unverified and has been replaced with user-adjustable timing.
jewelry-stores.exceptionalTakeNote: Standard corroborated takes range from $10,000 to $25,000 per store after fencing at Yasmani. Uncorroborated $35,000 figures have been retired; exceptional multi-case + full-safe boutique hauls may sit at the top of the $25,000 range depending on tier.

pawn-shops.name: 15 Pawn Shops (incl. Fast Cash)
pawn-shops.evidenceClassification: Corroborated by multiple reputable launch guides
pawn-shops.notes: 15 pawn shops unlocked in Chapter 2 after Coffee Break. Typical store runs pay $2,500–$6,500 fenced, with full safe clears / chained circuits reported up to $10,000–$12,000.

armored-trucks-gang-ops.name: Armored Trucks & 39 Core Gang Ops (40 w/ Ultimate Ed.)
armored-trucks-gang-ops.evidenceClassification: Corroborated by multiple reputable launch guides
armored-trucks-gang-ops.notes: 39 core Illegal Operations are required for 100% completion (Pause Menu > Progress > Gangs); 40 total locations exist when including the 1 Ultimate Edition exclusive.

shops-and-stickups.name: 72 Shops & Convenience Stick-Ups
shops-and-stickups.evidenceClassification: Corroborated by multiple reputable launch guides

storyModeMoneyMilestones.combinedPayoutDescription: Combined payout of the 10 listed Story Mode milestones (2 major Story Heists + 8 other story mission payouts and robbery unlocks — not the entire campaign total).

apollo-aggregates-red-barn.name: Apollo Aggregates (Red Barn) Save/Reload Loot Loop
apollo-aggregates-red-barn.officialPatchNoteStatus: Rockstar Games' official November 23, 2026 patch notes (01.002.002 / 1.0.2.2) list 7 fixes (including partner bag handover to fences) and do NOT document patching the Apollo Aggregates warehouse respawn loop.
apollo-aggregates-red-barn.communityReportStatus: Multiple post-patch community reports (MeowDB, Notebookcheck, RockstarIntel, Reddit) report the save/reload trunk restock loop still functions after Update 01.002.002 / 1.0.2.2. Not directly re-tested on a live console by this site.
